messages:
Maya: Heads up — Sales wants Orchard to pilot tenant-pinning + progressive traffic next week. Need a small PRD + rollout + safety runbook by tomorrow EOD. Who can help spec requirements and rollback rules?
Jorge: I can own the rollout spec. Will draft experiment matrix and acceptance criteria. Need SRE and CS thresholds.
Helen: From CS: success criteria = <1% absolute error increase, p95 latency increase <= +30ms, and no quality regression on the Orchard eval set. We'll supply the eval prompts today.
Liam: Proposal for stages: 2% for 24h, 10% for 48h, 50% for 6h, then 100%. Pin expiry 30d by default. Auto-rollback to previous variant on regression triggers.
Maya: Edge cases to cover: tenant traffic spikes, bursty background jobs, and sessions with long-running KV caches. Need per-tenant hard RPS cap and clear fallback.
SRE Sim: Suggested automated rollback triggers: error_rate delta >= 0.75% absolute OR p95 latency delta >= 50ms sustained for 10m OR healthcheck failure > 3 in 5m. Business metric drops (MRR/usage) requires manual review.
Jorge: Drafting rollback playbook and alert mappings. Any thoughts on evaluation cadence?
Helen: Run the eval prompt set every 30m during canary. Use embedding-similarity + token-delta heuristics and a small human sample every 6 hours. If embedding sim mean drops > 0.12 vs baseline -> pause.
Jorge: Config sketch: 
```
pin_config:
  tenant: orchard
  model_variant: gptx-v2-q4
  stages:
    - pct: 2; duration: "24h"
    - pct: 10; duration: "48h"
    - pct: 50; duration: "6h"
    - pct: 100; duration: "0h"
  expiry: "30d"
  rollback:
    - error_rate_delta: 0.75
    - latency_p95_ms_delta: 50
    - embedding_sim_delta: 0.12
```
Liam: Add a canary isolation rule: only route live user traffic for Orchard — no background indexing or batch jobs. Also simulate 10x spike during 2% to validate throttles.
Maya: Observability requirements: per-tenant dashboards (p50/p95/p99, errors, token counts), automated anomaly alerts, and a pre-baked runbook with exact steps for manual rollback and customer comms.
SRE Sim: We'll require: per-tenant circuit-breaker, per-tenant RPS quota, and an emergency fallback route to the hosted stable model variant. Add tracing hooks for request IDs. I can sign off once those are in the PRD.
Helen: CS will prepare the opt-in language, a one‑pager for Orchard, and an escalation contact list. Legal needs to confirm data residency constraints for the pilot.
Jorge: Also recommend a pin grace policy: if a model variant is removed or updated, existing pins fallback to the last compatible variant and admins get notified.
Liam: For automation: add a gating job that runs the eval set pre- and post-deploy; if delta metrics exceed thresholds, CI blocks stage promotion.
Maya: Timeline proposal: PRD draft by tomorrow 12:00, review cycle until 17:00, RFC published EOD, infra ready next Tue for canary. Can we hit that?
Jorge: Yep, I'll post the PRD draft in #prds and ping SRE/CS.
Liam: I'll prepare traffic spike test harness and a small script to replay Orchard session traces.
Maya: @DeployBot can you create the runbook + alerting ticket and link the initial draft when ready?
DeployBot: Created ticket BACKLOG-4721: "orchard-canary-runbook + alerts" — assigned to Jorge.
Helen: One more: require a customer-facing rollback FAQ and an opt-out URL for Orchard in case they want to stop the pilot quickly.
Maya: Great. I'll collate everything and post the PRD link here once it's up. Thanks all — let's keep the spec minimal and conservative for safety.
